name: isometric mid thighs pull
description: A max-effort pull against a fixed bar at mid-thigh height. It builds force production through the hips and back.
instructions: Set a bar in a rack at mid-thigh height and grip it just outside your legs.
Stand with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Brace your core and chest up.
Pull up on the bar as hard as you can without it moving.
Hold for 5 seconds, then release gradually.
